source_review.definition: Thomson equal-unit-charge Coulomb energy on exact unit S2; retain n32 and add n40/n50. Minimize reciprocal pair distances with exact stereographic points.
source_review.primary_sources: Sol personally fetched CCD /Thomson/xyz/40.xyz and /50.xyz and compared exact saved bytes and SHA256. CCD /Thomson/table.html reports rounded energies660.6752788 and1055.1823147. Wales-Ulker2006 conventional optimization coordinates are reconstructed; the archive does not supply global certificates.
source_review.open_status: CCD and Chen-Mehta2014 status evidence reviewed; no proof for n40/50 was found in reviewed sources. Small-n solved cases do not establish these instances. No exhaustive claim.
source_review.independent_method: Sol personally ran both human baselines and fixed references. Separate Fraction pair distances and integer-division-before-isqrt sums at scale1e35 enclose all780/1225 terms. Audit intervals fit formal scale1e25 bounds. Unit-sphere equations, distinctness, full claim invariance and corrupted points checked.
source_review.admission: All five strict programs and replay,cold export,error,nonfinite,timeout controls passed for all3 configs; source metadata and exact reference scores reconciled before final acceptance. Isolated single-file -I generation tests pass. Own incumbent preserved when its replay is at least as good.

configuration_expansion_review.evidence: CCD table rows and original xyz files archived in data/; witnesses independently rationalized and certified.
configuration_expansion_review.open_status_source: Chen and Mehta (2014), §III, report deterministic Thomson global-minimum results only for N=2,3,4,5,6,12; exact optima for N=40 and N=50 remain unestablished in the checked source.
